drafts.body:
Dear Pangaea team,

I noticed your company sources a wide range of hardware and kitchenware items. KaiLionCrafts is a direct cutlery and kitchen-hardware supplier based in Yangjiang, China - home to about 75% of the country's knife and scissors production.

We help importers like you consolidate sourcing: kitchen knives, scissors and kitchen accessories from four partner factories, with OEM/ODM from 100 pcs, SGS LFGB and FDA certifications, and factory-direct pricing about 20% below traders.

May I send you our latest catalog? Happy to quote on any items you currently buy.

Best,
Leo Li
KaiLionCrafts | WhatsApp: +86 131-3800-6564
kailioncrafts.com/yangjiang-advantage/
